attributes.title: 2027 TAMFT Annual Conference: Relational Courage
attributes.organizer: Texas Association for Marriage and Family Therapy
attributes.summary:
The 2027 program is built around difficult conversations, in the therapy room and between colleagues and supervisors. If conflict work with couples and families or a tense supervisory relationship is on your mind, that is the angle to look at when the session list appears.

The early rate runs through December 18, 2026, and the group hotel rate at the Renaissance Austin Downtown ends January 21, 2027, so both decisions come before the program feels close. TAMFT's 2027 page does not yet list CE hours; its 2026 conference advertised more than 15, including ethics, cultural diversity and supervision. Texas LMFTs should wait for the 2027 hour count before planning a renewal around it.
